egress.terms: SHARED-LINK TRAFFIC IS METERED. Verbatim from pCloud's own blog (Sep 2026): 'Each pCloud plan comes with a predetermined amount of link traffic each month. As of September, 2026, it is double the amount of your paid storage … Ultra | 10 TB | 20 TB | 2×'. Non-link (own-client) transfers are not metered.

chaining: WebDAV mount; lifetime plans available (2799→1499 EUR for 10 TB one-time on the pricing page)
limits_note: 2× storage as monthly shared-link traffic; on exceed links are suspended until next month
reliability_note: It would work at the low end of serving and break at the top.
